module_summary: AXI-Stream N:1 switch: each input stream passes through a skid buffer, an AXI-lite programmed index selects which one is muxed to a registered output, switching only between packets.

anchors.name: r_index
anchors.why: AXI-lite written register holding requested input stream index; read back over RDATA.

anchors.name: switch_index
anchors.why: Active stream select, updated from r_index only between packets; muxes skid data to output.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Registered output stream valid from selected skid buffer valid.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Registered output data muxed from skd_data by switch_index.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TREADY
anchors.why: Downstream ready; stalls output registers and blocks skid buffer reads.

anchors.name: M_AXIS_TLAST
anchors.why: Output packet-end marker; drives mid_packet tracking.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TVALID
anchors.why: Per-stream input valid vector feeding the per-stream skid buffers.

anchors.name: S_AXIS_TDATA
anchors.why: Concatenated input stream data sliced into per-stream skid buffers.

anchors.name: skd_switch_ready
anchors.why: One-hot ready to skid buffers; only selected stream drains, blocked on stall or pending switch.

anchors.name: mid_packet
anchors.why: Indicates a packet is in progress; prevents switch_index change until TLAST.

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite write accept: loads r_index and raises BVALID.

anchors.name: skd_valid
anchors.why: Per-stream skid buffer output valids, gated by skd_switch_ready into M_AXIS_TVALID.

anchors.name: skd_data
anchors.why: Per-stream skid buffer output data array, mux inputs for M_AXIS_TDATA.

anchors.name: axil_read_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite read accept: sets read valid for r_index readback.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite write response valid copied from axil_bvalid.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite read data valid copied from axil_read_valid.

anchors.name: axil_read_data
anchors.why: Read data register holding r_index for AXI-lite readback.

anchors.name: wskd_index
anchors.why: Byte-strobe merged write data used to update r_index.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: AXI-lite write data carrying the new stream index.

groups.name: AXI-lite control registers
groups.description: Skid-buffered AXI-lite slave writing and reading back the requested stream index r_index.

groups.name: Input stream skid buffers
groups.description: One skid buffer per input stream holding data until selected by the switch.

groups.name: Switch control
groups.description: Tracks packet boundaries and updates switch_index; generates one-hot ready for selected stream.

groups.name: Output stream register
groups.description: Registered output mux of selected stream data, last and valid with backpressure.
